programme.title: Entrevista Com O Hitman
programme.desc: Viktor é um assassino profissional romeno de elite, que fingiu a própria morte para mudar de vida mas cujo passado o vem perseguir e pôr em risco todos os seus planos.

programme.title: Sin City Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: Golpe De Amor
programme.desc: Quando Richard percebe que a sua empresa foi vendida a um empresário fraudulento e que os fundos de pensões de todos os funcionários desapareceram, decide juntar-se à ex-mulher para recuperar o dinheiro, numa aventura pela Europa que envolve perseguições loucas e roubo de joias.

programme.title: A Balada De Adam Henry
programme.desc: Fiona Maye é uma juíza que tem de julgar o caso de um adolescente de 17 anos com leucemia que é Testemunha de Jeová e se recusa, por motivos religiosos, a receber uma transfusão de sangue que o poderá ajudar a salvar a vida.

programme.title: O Demónio De Ravens Hollow
programme.desc: Durante um exercício de treino a norte de Nova Iorque, Edgar Allan Poe, cadete da academia militar de West Point, e quatro outros cadetes, encontram um homem eviscerado. As suas últimas palavras remetem o grupo para uma comunidade esquecida, que eles acreditam estar a esconder terríveis segredos.

programme.title: Rockn Roll
programme.desc: Uma jovem atriz chama à realidade o seu colega Guillaume Canet durante a rodagem de um filme, dizendo-lhe que ele deixou de ser um sex-symbol desde que se acomodou à vida doméstica com Marion Cotillard. Agora ele vai ter de reaver a sua imagem e provar que ainda é uma estrela rockn roll.

programme.title: Mojin E O Templo Perdido
programme.desc: No início da década de 90, o famoso explorador de túmulos Hu Bayi decidiu reformar-se com a sua noiva, Shirley, mas são convencidos a regressar às lides por uma mulher misteriosa, que quer descobrir o túmulo de uma princesa mongol para possuir um artefacto que tem o poder de ressuscitar os mortos.

programme.title: Medida Provisória
programme.desc: Num futuro distópico, o governo brasileiro decreta uma medida provisória que obriga os cidadãos negros a regressarem a África, como forma de reparar os erros cometidos na era da escravatura, o que provoca o caos, protestos e um movimento de resistência que vai inspirar a nação.

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Academia De Polícia
programme.desc: A Academia de Polícia abriu as portas a todos. Agora, os candidatos já não têm que se preocupar com problemas de altura, peso e outros pré-requisitos... até mesmo a inteligência passa a ser opcional. Os instrutores é que não estão pelos ajustes e vão tentar meter na ordem os mais indisciplinados.

programme.title: Covil De Ladrões
programme.desc: A unidade de elite de combate ao crime de Los Angeles, que nem sempre joga pelas regras, entra em confronto com o gangue de assalto a bancos mais bem sucedido da cidade. Quando os fora-da-lei decidem assaltar a Reserva Federal, qual dos dois se revelará o mais implacável

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: A Máscara
programme.desc: O tímido bancário Stanley Ipkiss encontra uma mascara misteriosa. Quando a coloca, transforma-se num ser enérgico e ultra-acelerado, de rosto verde e poderes muito especiais.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: Praxx Fim De Semana
programme.desc: Inverno, sexta-feira. Um grupo de jovens universitários parte para um fim de semana em São João da Cruz, para celebrar a sua ascensão na prestigiada Associação da Vida Académica. A diversão dos jovens acaba por dar lugar ao terror quando à noite, na Praia da Cruz, um ritual de praxe é levado ao limite.

programme.title: Os Medos De Rain
programme.desc: Uma rapariga que vive com esquizofrenia luta com alucinações terríveis quando começa a suspeitar que o seu vizinho sequestrou uma criança. A única pessoa que acredita nela é Caleb, um miúdo que ela nem tem a certeza de que existe.

programme.title: True Justice A Vingança É Minha
programme.desc: Depois da sua antiga equipa ter sido assassinada, o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane recruta novos membros para formar um esquadrão implacável de combate ao crime, prometendo vingar a morte dos antigos companheiros.

programme.title: True Justice Via De Sangue
programme.desc: Elijah Kane envolve-se numa nova missão governamental para tentar apanhar um mafioso envolvido em tráfico de pessoas e descobre uma conspiração mais alargada de venda de órgãos humanos.

programme.title: True Justice Ações Violentas
programme.desc: Enquanto investiga o desaparecimento de uma carrinha de segurança que transportava 20 milhões de dólares, o antigo soldado das forças especiais Elijah Kane vai enfrentar um perigoso mafioso, uma organização misteriosa chamada Quicksilver e uma figura do passado que ele e a CIA julgavam morta.

programme.title: After
programme.desc: Tessa, uma rapariga bem-comportada de dezoito anos, conhece na faculdade Hardin, um rapaz rude e rico com um passado sombrio, por quem se apaixona e com o qual perde a virgindade. Os dois embarcam numa relação turbulenta e intensa, que os mudará para sempre.

programme.title: Está Tudo Louco
programme.desc: Um magnata jogador decide criar um novo veículo para apostas a dinheiro uma corrida de mais de 900 quilómetros, de um casino de Las Vegas até uma estação de comboio no Novo México, onde se encontra um saco com dois milhões de dólares, que ficará para quem lá chegar primeiro.

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: Na Corda Bamba
programme.desc: Há muito tempo, Rick Jarmin testemunhou contra um grupo de criminosos e desde então tem vivido escondido ao abrigo do Programa de Proteção de Testemunhas. Mas tudo se complica quando ele dá de caras com a antiga namorada, e ela reconhece-o...

programme.title: Pelé O Nascimento De Uma Lenda
programme.desc: Esta é a extraordinária história do lendário jogador de futebol Pelé, desde a sua infância até se tornar no jovem que, aos 17 anos de idade, marcou o golo decisivo na primeira vitória de sempre do Brasil num Campeonato do Mundo, em 1958.

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos

programme.title: Dog A Aventura De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Briggs, um ex-ranger do exército, é encarregue de conduzir Lulu, um pastor belga militar de comportamento agressivo, pela costa do Pacífico até ao funeral do seu dono, numa jornada em que ambos terão de lidar com os traumas do seu passado e encontrar um ponto de equilíbrio.

programme.title: Estado De Guerra
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra do Iraque, um novo sargento assume o comando de uma equipa altamente treinada em desmantelamento de bombas. No meio de conflitos violentos, com a cidade a explodir num absoluto caos, ele vai revelar a sua verdadeira personalidade e mudará para sempre aqueles homens.

programme.title: Pandemónio
programme.desc: Quando um vírus letal, capaz de tornar as pessoas extremamente violentas e selvagens, se alastra num edifício de escritórios, o advogado Derek Cho e uma cliente insatisfeita terão de unir esforços para lutar pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: Henrique V
programme.desc: No decorrer da Guerra dos Cem Anos, o jovem rei Henrique V de Inglaterra lidera o seu exército na luta contra França em 1415.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 3, Op. 14
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Piano Sonata No. 3 in F minor, Op. 14 (a 'Concerto for piano without orchestra', in the words of music publisher Tobias Haslinger) in 1836. He dedicated it to piano virtuoso Ignaz Moscheles.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Wolf, De Falla, Poulenc a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Sophia Burgos (USA, 1991) and pianist Daniel Gerzenberg (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Ich esse nun mein Brod nicht trocken mehr’, ‘Wer rief dich den?’, ‘Schweig’ einmal still, du garst’ger Schwätzer dort!

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Novelletten, Op. 21. The eight pieces for piano that make up this song cycle are often performed separately. It bears a dedication to pianist Adolph Henselt.

programme.title: Wagner - Parsifal Act I. Prelude
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler’s Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale – a child’s vision of Heaven – lies a world of profound emotion and beauty.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Composed between 1901 and 1902, Mahler's Fifth Symphony marked a significant shift in his compositional style, moving away from vocal elements toward a purely symphonic structure. It's a work of immense scope and emotional depth, known for its rich orchestral textures and intricate counterpoint.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: Donizetti - Lucia di Lammermoor
programme.desc: Italian conductor Speranza Scappucci leads the Philharmonia Zürich and the Chorus of the Opernhaus Zürich in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s tragic opera ‘Lucia di Lammermoor’ (1835). Salvatore Cammarano based his libretto on Sir Walter Scott’s novel ‘The Bride of Lammermoor’ (1819). Set in 17th century Scotland, the opera tells the story of Lucia, who falls in love with Edgardo, her family’s arch enemy.

programme.title: Handel at Chambord Castle
programme.desc: This 2016 concert at Chambord Castle in France under the direction of Hervé Niquet features 70 musicians that gave a spectacular performance of Handel‘s Water Music and Music for the Royal Fireworks. In between Le Concert Spirituel also plays Concerto Grosso’s No. 4 and No. 5 also by Georg Friedrich Handel.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 99
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Trio élégiaque No. 1
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 3, 8 And 11
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Piano works by Bruckner
programme.desc: Lithuanian pianist Vadim Chaimovich (*1978) has won several prizes at international piano competitions, such as the Schubert Competition in Dortmund, the William Kapell International Piano Competition in Maryland, and the 29th Masterplayers International Music Competition in Lugano. Moreover, the pianist has performed in several European countries, Japan, and the USA , and has played at many international music festivals.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy led by French conductor Jean-Jacques Kantorow. First on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sinfonia Concertante in E-flat major, K.

programme.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn And Gershwin for 2 Pianos
programme.desc: Italian pianists Roberto Prosseda and Alessandra Ammara perform W. A. Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 488, Felix Mendelssohn's Sonata for two pianos in D major, MWV S 1, and George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, during an off-season concert recorded at Fazioli Concert Hall in Sacile, Italy in June 26, 2020.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the “Giuseppe Nicolini,” Conservatory of Piacenza, and the “Giuseppe Verdi,” Conservatory of Milan, as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme”. On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. His Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the famous trilogy by writer J. R. R Tolkien.

programme.title: Gaming X Symphony - Legends And Quests
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris. The program continues with Shostakovich's Symphony No.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 111
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 55
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Duke Ellington live at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: Duke Ellington: Live in '58 features the earliest-known filmed full-length concert by one of the 20th Century's greatest songwriters and bandleaders. Filmed at Amsterdam's famed Concertgebouw, this 80-minute concert features the 16-piece Duke Ellington Orchestra two years after their stunning performance at the 1956 Newport Jazz Festival, which Duke considered his second birth.

programme.title: S. Quintet, Hubbard And Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Bakolo Music International - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival.

programme.title: The Jackson Singers
programme.desc: The American gospel group The Jackson Singers, founded by Bob Jackson in 1980, found a warm welcome in Europe, where they have toured for decades. Embraced for their powerful spirituals and gospel music, they have become a celebrated presence in churches, cathedrals, and jazz festivals across the continent.

programme.title: Three Cohens
programme.desc: They are three siblings, born in Israel, passed through New York, each leading brilliant careers. The youngest, Avishai, has established himself as one of the most original trumpet players of the moment, author of highly acclaimed albums on the ECM label. The second youngest, Anat, saxophonist and clarinetist, in love with Brazilian music and Benny Goodman, is one of the great 'jazzwomen' of today.

programme.title: Tell Me Why
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Ray Charles and the Raelettes - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Children of the Night
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Live at the Office: BIGYUKI And Now vs Now
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Calypso
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Milonga Noctiva
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan 'The Divine One' in 1958
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Eartha Kitt: The Most Exciting Woman in the World
programme.desc: They called her “the most exciting woman in the world”, and this Afro-American voice lived up to this expectation with international flair. Eartha Kitt was one of the reigning queens of blues and jazz. She epitomized the idea of the sex-kitten chanteuse, rising to fame with a nightclub act centered on her slinky stage presence and throaty purr.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Walter Trout Band - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Herbie Mann - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: George Benson and Earl Klugh - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Poinciana
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Keb' Mo
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: November Music 2017: Daniel Herskedal
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands. Norwegian tuba player and composer Daniel Herskedal trained at the Trondheim and Copenhagen Music Conservatories.

programme.title: Trio Corrente - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Etienne Mbappe - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Nica's Dream
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Marion Williams Sings Spirituals
programme.desc: You can’t help but be carried away by the powerful voice Marion Williams, who, with backing from Tommy Brown (piano), Joe Washington (organ), Billy Tuliver (drums), and singers Barbara White and Ann Bolden, sings gospel songs and spirituals as if she has lived them a thousand times over. The repertoire includes such familiar tunes as “Peace in the Valley,” “We Shall Overcome,” and “Michael, Row the Boat Ashore.”.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kurt Elling
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Ochun Chucho
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Joel Hierrezuelo - Asi de Simple
programme.desc: Cuban singer, guitarist and percussionist Joel Hierrezuelo is known as the vocalist of the band Ricoson. He played percussion in the band Temperamento with Roberto Fonseca, Javier Zalba, and Ruy Lopez Nousa, and has worked with artists such as Alfredo Rodriguez and Los Acerekó, Omara Portuondo, Fatoumata Diawara, and Mayra Andrade.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Christian Scott
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Parisien meets Kühn And Portal
programme.desc: Since his first appearance at Jazz in Ramatuelle in 2010, saxophonist Émile Parisien has made his mark among the most talented musicians of his generation. On the soprano saxophone, his favorite instrument, he invented a unique lyrical style.

programme.title: Episode 4: Stan Getz - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz tenor saxophonist Stan Getz (1927-1991) was nicknamed 'The Sound' for his warm, lyrical tone. Performing in bebop and cool jazz groups, he popularized bossa nova in America with the hit 'The Girl from Ipanema'.

programme.title: Peter Beets: Chopin meets the Blues
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Michel Camilo Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent’s orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel - Bandit 65
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty.

programme.title: Phalanx - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax’ took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: A Rota T9 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja pelo mundo à descoberta da história, cultura e gastronomia dos locais.Com reportagens produzidas localmente em diferentes países e eventos, as nossas viagens são feitas por uma equipa, que se deslocam de avião, barco ou carro à procura de novos territórios para explorar e novas aventuras para experienciar.

programme.title: Vidas Transformadas T4 - Ep. 28

programme.title: Informação Ao Minuto T3 - Ep. 88

Com uma abordagem rigorosa e acessível, o programa cedido pela TV Maná 1 à Kuriakos TV, destaca os temas mais relevantes do momento — da política à economia, da sociedade à cultura — garantindo uma informação atualizada e de confiança.

programme.title: Na Rota Dos Angolanos T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja à descoberta dos angolanos espalhados por todo o mundo, com reportagens produzidas não só em Angola mas também um pouco por todo o mundo onde se encontrem angolanos.Com uma componente humana e social sempre presente, faz parte integrante dos nossos objectivos traçados, a interacção com os angolanos, tornando assim o programa em muito mais do que uma colectânea de imagens.

programme.title: Recherche Appartement Ou Maison
programme.desc: À Paris, Marie-Jo, 68 ans, ex-styliste reconvertie dans la peinture, doit quitter son appartement de Pigalle dans trois mois. Elle souhaite réduire sa surface pour compléter sa retraite et envisage un pied-à-terre dans le Sud. Ses exigences sont strictes : un bien atypique, avec travaux, uniquement dans le 2e arrondissement ! Thibault Chanel devra redoubler d'efforts pour trouver l'appartement à son image. Dans l'Hérault, trois...

programme.title: Recherche Appartement Ou Maison
programme.desc: Caroline, 35 ans, et Esteban, 37 ans, vivent dans l’appartement de Caroline au cœur de Saint-Étienne mais rêvent de nature et d’un grand atelier pour Esteban. Sandra Viricel va sillonner le parc naturel régional du Pilat. Trouvera-t-elle leur bonheur ? Benoît, 46 ans, et Emmanuelle, 42 ans, forment une famille recomposée avec leurs enfants respectifs. Ils vivent en location à Metz, mais le manque d'espace les empêche d'accueillir...

programme.title: Un Jour, Un Doc
programme.desc: Grands débats de société, nouvelles tendances, retour sur des évènements marquants et des faits divers hors normes, ou encore récits de vie des people et des têtes couronnées, « Un jour, un doc » propose tous les après-midis une grande variété de documentaires et de sujets qui font vibrer le cœur des Français. Chaque jour, partez à la découverte d’histoires et de personnages incroyables en France ou à l’étranger.

programme.title: Un Jour, Un Doc
programme.desc: Grands débats de société, nouvelles tendances, retour sur des évènements marquants et des faits divers hors normes, ou encore récits de vie des people et des têtes couronnées, « Un jour, un doc » propose tous les après-midis une grande variété de documentaires et de sujets qui font vibrer le cœur des Français. programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Le chef Philippe Etchebest se rend à Wambrechies, dans le Nord, dans le restaurant d’Ophélie et Sébastien. Pour la première fois depuis le début de Cauchemar en cuisine, le chef va intervenir chez un maître restaurateur ; un gage de qualité normalement ! Mais très vite, Philippe Etchebest va se rendre compte que Sébastien n’est pas tout à fait à la hauteur du titre : entre une carte incohérente, un service approximatif et du poisson...

programme.title: Cauchemar En Cuisine
programme.desc: Philippe Etchebest intervient à Saint-Bonnet-en-Champsaur, au cœur des Hautes-Alpes. C’est ici que Béatrice et Stéphane ont ouvert leur restaurant il y a presque trois ans. Dès son arrivée, le chef est frappé par l’état des lieux : désordre dès l’entrée, salle sombre et sans âme... Et, en cuisine, la situation se dégrade avec une hygiène plus que douteuse : hotte encrassée, paniers de friteuse noirs et frigo envahi par la glace....

programme.title: Superestruturas Nazis T6 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A luta de Hitler pelos céus faz com que o Reich adote uma política de 'Guerra Total'. Cada homem, mulher e criança é pressionado a produzir cada vez mais aviões e munições. O resultado é um dos sistemas de defesa mais eficazes que o mundo já viu. Um sistema que esteve muito perto de destruir a poderosa 8th Army Airforce dos EUA..

programme.title: Superestruturas Nazis T6 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando os espiões aliados colocam documentos falsos num cadáver, executam uma das ciladas mais engenhosas na Segunda Guerra Mundial. A Operação 'Mincemeat' assegura que a invasão aliada da Sicília apanha os Nazis de surpresa.

programme.title: Libertação: Do Dia D A Berlim T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Em 1944, a invasão da Europa ocupada pelos nazis pelos Aliados traz ao povo francês a esperança da liberdade e a devastação da guerra.

programme.title: A Ciência da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A Ciência da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 3

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Deslizar pelo corrimão de uma escadaria com uma aceleração dos 0 aos 97 quilómetros por hora em menos de 4 segundos parece fantástico. Isto é, até encontrar uma força de intensidade igual mas de direcção inversa e dá por si no chão. O desafio do balde de gelo foi um sucesso nos media sociais mas alguns participantes não agarraram no balde correctamente e levaram com ele na cabeça.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: O Inverno traz neve, gelo e divertimento, quando desfrutado com moderação! Saltos de mota de neve podem ser muito divertidos até o excesso de rotação e ambição mandar os pilotos contra a neve de cabeça. Deslizar no gelo é sempre uma boa experiência se souber manter o equilíbrio na ausência de fricção! Quando não conseguir, provavelmente irá deslizar com a sua cara. Saltar à corda é uma tarefa simples que envolve velocidade e timing.

programme.title: Tucci Em Itália T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Stanley mergulha nos mitos e mistérios desta ilha selvagem, descobrindo uma gastronomia tão singular quanto a sua geografia.

programme.title: Tucci Em Itália T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Stanley descobre como a adversidade moldou esta região emblemática, revelando que a sua história marcada por dificuldades deu origem a inovações culinárias criativas.

programme.title: Tucci Em Itália T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Stanley explora os tesouros gastronómicos desta região menos conhecida e questiona-se como é que tantas maravilhas passaram despercebidas aos turistas internacionais.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O inverno prolongado levou a nova geração ao limite. Os Brown testam corajosamente novos locais de pesca na esperança de apanharem uma recompensa para a família. Johnny Rolfe constrói uma cabana de degelo para processar a sua única porção de carne para o inverno.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Os habitantes do Alasca defendem o seu estilo de vida de subsistência de predadores próximos e distantes. Os Brown tentam proteger a sua quinta quando os sinais da presença de lobos estão cada vez mais perto. Johnny Rolfe pensa num novo design de casaco para Java, a sua companheira de quatro patas.

programme.title: Alasca: A Nova Geração T6 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Os habitantes do Alasca têm de se preparar para tudo o que a Mãe Natureza lhes reserve. Johnny Rolfe leva Java para longe do acampamento para caçar, mas é apanhado de surpresa por uma manada de renas, enquanto a família Roach, depois de muitas tentativas, consegue apanhar peixe-preto.

programme.title: Primal Survivor T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hazen Audel embarca numa desafiante missão na selva, baseada na tradicional caminhada a solo, feita pelos jovens da tribo Embera. Hazen deixará para trás a segurança da aldeia da tribo Embera e aventurar-se-á no coração de um dos ambientes mais hostis e desafiantes do mundo - as florestas chuvosas da conhecida Região de Darién.

programme.title: Primal Survivor T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Hazen Audel embarca numa desafiante missão a solo para entregar 200 renas, sãs e salvas, no local de nascimento de Primavera, dentro do Círculo Ártico. Esta é uma viagem terrestre extraordinária pelo Ártico selvagem que Hazen enfrenta a pé e a puxar um trenó de 90 quilos. Ele lidera a sua manada por rios congelados, através de tempestades de neve e nevões e até sobre lagos congelados. Conseguirá ele levar a manada para novas pastagens?

programme.title: Primal Survivor T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Nas selvas do Sudeste Asiático, Hazen tem de usar as suas habilidades dos pescadores Lao Loum para trepar para o coração das poderosas cascatas e apanhar peixes nos rápidos letais de água branca. Para chegar a estes ricos locais de pesca, ele tem de enfrentar turbilhões, subir a árvores cheias de cobras e palmilhar a selva densa a transbordar de insectos.

programme.title: Primal Survivor T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Munido apenas de ferramentas básicas e das antigas habilidades dos Maasai, Hazen tem de subir 2100 metros até ao topo de um vulcão para fazer uma oferenda em nome da sua tribo. Mas para lá chegar, ele tem de andar em estreitos íngremes, subir passagens de montanha e atravessar a savana, onde os grandes gatos caçam as descansadas presas e crocodilos patrulham os cursos de água..

programme.title: Situação Crítica T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: A 4 de Março de 2002, O SEAL da Marinha Neil Roberts prepara-se para uma missão no Sudeste Afeganistão. A tecnologia que dispunham indica que a área está livre de perigo, mas rapidamente a tranquilidade se converte no caos assim que o helicóptero é atingido por um rocket..

programme.title: Bastidores Da Cia: Segredos E Espiões T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: O gene da ausência de medo: num país onde a pena para espionagem é a morte, uma jovem agente da CIA — inspiração na vida real para Carrie Matheson de Homeland — é raptada à força durante uma troca rotineira de informações. Isolada e sob ameaça, terá de confiar no seu treino e instintos para sobreviver a um confronto de 24 horas que pode terminar em catástrofe.

programme.title: Bastidores Da Cia: Segredos E Espiões T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O final à Hollywood: para um agente da CIA a tentar recrutar espiões durante um dos períodos mais sangrentos de conflito no Médio Oriente, pode ser difícil confiar num infiltrado na rede da Al-Qaida, mas ainda mais difícil é mantê-lo vivo.

programme.title: Bastidores Da Cia: Segredos E Espiões T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma vida dupla dentro de uma vida dupla: uma ex-agente da CIA usa as suas competências de retirada segura e a sua rede de contactos para ajudar a resgatar pessoas durante a retirada dos EUA do Afeganistão em 2021.

programme.title: Alasca: Os Primeiros Habitantes T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Os nativos do Alasca asseguram a subsistência da sua comunidade tal como os seus antepassados o fizeram nas mesmas terras. Chris e Nalu Apassingok enfrentam os mares agitados para apanhar pássaros. Marvin Agnot repara a campa do pai com a ajuda da sua sobrinha e dos seus filhos. John e Teresa Pingayak constroem os alicerces da cabana da família. Joel Jacko ajuda a sua avó emprestada a pescar.

programme.title: Alasca: Os Primeiros Habitantes T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Seguindo as pisadas dos seus antepassados, a geração mais nova parte para a floresta para garantir o sustento das suas famílias.

programme.title: Alasca: Os Primeiros Habitantes T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Cooperando com as suas famílias, os Povos Indígenas do Alasca sobrevivem e prosperam nas terras dos seus antepassados. Tig Strassburg ensina as suas filhas a caçar alces. Jody Potts-Joseph regressa a casa para a sua aldeia natal, Eagle. Marvin Agnot pesca alabote com a irmã, a sobrinha e a sobrinha-neta. Daniel Apassingok trabalha com a filha em perseguição da sua primeira foca.

programme.title: Alasca: Os Primeiros Habitantes T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Os povos indígenas do Alasca transmitem valores tradicionais as seus filhos e partilham a sua ligação à terra que sempre habitaram. John e Teresa Pingayak juntam-se às suas filhas adultas na caça às focas. Tig Strassburg e Louise Moses mostram às filhas como lançar uma rede de pesca. Joel Jacko melhora a sustentabilidade da sua casa. Marvin Agnot ensina a sobrinha-neta a caçar um veado. .

programme.title: Alasca: Os Primeiros Habitantes T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: O povo indígena do Alasca reconstrói as suas comunidades após o Tufão Merbok. John e Teresa Pingayak viajam até ao campo para averiguar os estragos e reconstruir o seu abrigo. Daniel e Nalu Apassingok tentam a sua sorte a caçar focas e recuperam um barco. Tig e Evan Strassburg montam armadilhas na esperança de apanharem coelhos. E Joel Jacko viaja até um lago remoto para pescar lúcio antes que o Inverno chegue.

programme.title: Alasca: Os Primeiros Habitantes T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Um Inverno escuro aproxima-se e os nativos do Alasca usam a pouca luz para caçar para subsistência e manterem-se alerta para não serem eles os caçados.

programme.title: Alasca: Os Primeiros Habitantes T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Desafiados pelo clima, predadores e políticas, os nativos do Alasca sobrevivem nas suas terras árticas. Joel Jacko enfrenta um urso cada vez mais audaz. Tig Strassburg e Louise Moses tentam a sua sorte na pesca sob o rio congelado. A família Apassingok aventura-se no Mar de Bering em busca de carne fresca. E Marvin Agnot luta contra as marés para apanhar caranguejo-real para a sua família.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T8 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Curly aproveita uma pausa entre tempestades para caçar veados numa zona fértil a que não conseguia aceder há alguns anos.

programme.title: Resgate Abaixo De Zero T5 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Um camião que se encontra preso bloqueia uma estrada principal e Thord tem de o resgatar, mas o condutor não quer pagar. Por isso, ameaça-o com prisão domiciliária.

programme.title: Resgate Abaixo De Zero T5 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Thord faz tudo o que pode para resgatar um camião que está a bloquear um desfiladeiro de montanha, enquanto condutores impacientes colocam a vida dele em risco.

programme.desc: O tempo escasseia e a chegada da polícia aumenta a pressão quando Thord luta para colocar um veículo de 16 rodas de volta na estrada.

programme.desc: Ao longo da história, os monumentos colossais dos nossos antepassados refletiram a sua determinação em deixar uma marca duradoura no mundo. O Coliseu guarda segredos profundos do engenho romano. A extensão serpenteante da Grande Muralha da China esconde pistas sobre a sua construção.
